body.objective: Classify every evolution-invariant quasifree covariance on the certified homogeneous Berger metric-antifield block after the stationary compatible-complex-structure obstruction, and decide exactly what positive, indefinite or nonstationary structures remain possible on that reduced carrier.
body.stop_condition: Import commit 31875f5b6 and BERGER_C26_NORMALIZED_HADAMARD_REPRESENTATIVE_OBSTRUCTION by exact hashes. Use the exact common characteristic polynomial and action-derived commutator/Krein form to solve the full linear matrix equations for real, Hermitian and evolution-invariant two-point covariances on the homogeneous block, including the two simple real evolution eigenline pairs. Classify positivity, degeneracy, Krein signature, purity and compatibility with the real involution; prove a no-go if positivity is impossible or export the complete parameter cone if candidates exist. Separate stationary covariances from explicitly time-dependent alternatives and state which microlocal/Hadamard conditions are undefined on this finite reduced block. Land exact algebraic certificates, an independent solver/verifier and mutations of the real roots, commutator and involution.
body.current_gate: complete reduced homogeneous covariance cone after failure of stationary compatible complex structure
